reviews.text: Sara has been super nice to us.
They didn't answer my WhatsApp message!
We're delighted to hear you had a positive experience at our Sanchinarro veterinary clinic! Your feedback motivates us to keep improving. Have a great day, Antonio!

I don't know what they're like as veterinarians, but I needed to buy a bag of dog food for my dog ​​(due to personal circumstances, it's impossible for me to travel further to buy it right now), and they very rudely told me they wouldn't sell it to me, that they were on emergency duty. To clarify, the clinic was completely empty, and they only let me in after keeping me waiting at the door for several minutes, having seen me, since there were two of them right there at reception... Seeing their lack of empathy, I would never bring my dog ​​here again.

The service and care are extraordinary, both from the doctors and the administrative staff. We want to highlight the excellent care of Dr. Irene and Dr. Oscar, who recently treated Kuno and Indigo, our beloved fur babies. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
It's a pleasure to receive reviews like this, Daniel! We want to thank you for taking the time to leave your comment and we hope to see you here again very soon. Best regards!

Three weeks ago, I took my cat Maya to this clinic for a kidney problem (infection). Everything went very well; the staff was friendly and very thorough. She recovered by following the instructions and medication, and I was very happy with them. The cost was a bit high, but in the end, it doesn't matter when it's my "baby." Now comes the unpleasant part. Two days ago, Maya got sick again, with moans and refusing to eat, so we had to take her back. This time, unfortunately, I wasn't lucky enough to see the same veterinarian or staff as last time. We had to wait three hours. The usual thing: they had to run tests. They did, and we had to pay a little over €300. We paid, and they told us it was just gastroenteritis, to give her the medication, and see how it went. After 48 hours, my cat's condition worsened dramatically. She wasn't eating, wasn't defecating, barely urinating, and was very lethargic. So we went back to the clinic, and I encountered the rudest and most indifferent person there, Sara. She had little empathy, and apparently, money came before health, including emotional blackmail. We had to repeat the tests, and to our surprise, it wasn't just a simple case of gastroenteritis. So, another €700 in no time! The next day, another €300 because she had to stay another day for observation, medication, etc. What can I say? I'm saddened by what happened during these last visits because I had been very satisfied before and had recommended the clinic. But now I'm left with a bitter taste in my mouth and an empty wallet. At least I hope my cat is okay. I'm definitely not going back there. Sara, if you read this, I would take a course in empathy and tact if I were you. I might even change jobs. I hope things go well for you!

The customer service and management at Caservet Sanchinarro was appalling!

I went to the clinic on Av. de Isabel de Valois with my two cats. Just before the check-up began, I was informed that the blood work and ultrasound would cost an additional €163. When I booked the appointment through the main office, they were careful to clarify that the tests would be done "if necessary," but they completely failed to mention that they were NOT covered by the plan I pay for monthly precisely to avoid these kinds of surprises.

To make matters worse, the service at the branch itself was terrible. Instead of offering a solution, Tamara and her reception colleagues shirked all responsibility and washed their hands of the problem, blaming the main office and saying, "We didn't book the appointment; it was scheduled by the main office." No one took responsibility, no one apologized, and they didn't even bother to change the appointment type in the system, even though both my bookings were clearly listed as "general consultation."

It's an absolute disgrace how they treat their customers. How sad to have to stop going to a clinic we trusted simply because their employees don't do their jobs responsibly.

A word of advice to everyone reading this so you don't end up like us: carefully check the type of appointment you're given and confirm it's covered by your plan, or be prepared to spend over €200 (in addition to your monthly fee), because they're going to start charging you for absolutely everything.
The emergency room staff are amazing. They're all so nice and professional ☺️

Our dog was diagnosed in June with two herniated discs and the need for complicated surgery (two surgeons). After the summer break, and after treating him with oral medication, we had to go back for a check-up. The good news from Dr. Óscar was that he had seen a very noticeable improvement and that, for now, surgery was no longer necessary. Obviously, we want surgery to be the last resort, so we are incredibly happy and grateful for the professionalism and honesty of his doctor, who specializes in neocolonial cancer (Óscar). We have a CaserVet plan and they have always treated us well, but I think this is worth sharing. Thank you!!
From arriving worried due to an emergency, to leaving calm, well-informed, and grateful for the professionalism and attention, it has to cause a well-deserved review of maximum satisfaction.
At Caservet, we appreciate your feedback and are delighted that your experience was positive. We hope to see you again soon, Ana!
That's not true, they're not a 24-hour emergency service. They're closed on Sundays.
Thank you so much for choosing us, Eugenio! We're delighted that you had a positive experience at our veterinary clinic. Best regards!

I took my cat to the emergency clinic yesterday because she was limping on her hind legs. While it's true that the daytime emergency consultation is more expensive than a regular appointment (€67 vs. €49), we had no other option since we showed up unannounced and were worried. We didn't think the price difference was excessive.
The care was excellent, both from the reception staff and from Sandra, the veterinarian who saw us. The kitten was nervous and wouldn't let us examine her, but Sandra was patient and tried different approaches. Finally, to take an X-ray and examine her properly, we had to anesthetize her. They took care of everything, and afterwards, we received a clear and detailed report of all the assessments and the treatment.
It was my first time there, and it was a good experience.

The staff are very attentive, helpful, and competent.

For me, it's my go-to veterinary clinic.

And for my cat too 😉
The emergency consultation costs €105 (consultation only, then add the cost of any other treatment your pet receives).
Hi A.! Thank you so much for your feedback. At Caservet, we work every day to keep improving and offering the best insurance to our clients. Best regards!

A very disappointing experience. We took our dog to the emergency clinic and they charged us €300 for probiotics and an X-ray that wasn't even conclusive because the dog wouldn't stop moving. They didn't do any further tests, and we had to return that same afternoon because he had worsened. Then they told us he was dehydrated and had to be hospitalized for the entire week.

During his stay, they performed numerous tests without clearly explaining their purpose, while the bill kept increasing. The worst part wasn't the money, but the lack of communication and the feeling that from the very beginning he didn't receive the care he needed. We won't be going back. And I don't recommend taking your pets to this clinic. A rip-off!
It's not open 24 hours as Maps says.
It's a pleasure to receive reviews like this, Carlos! We want to thank you for taking the time to leave your comment and we hope to see you here again very soon. Cheers!

Terrible experience with the clinic's clients. It's clear they're only interested in making money and couldn't care less about the animal's well-being.
Likewise, their treatment of the animals has been degrading on several occasions. Very disappointed.
First visit. All the staff were lovely, and the vet explained everything great.

Thorough and professional, my pet received excellent care and we are very happy. The staff is always very kind and patient, and the animals are very well looked after and loved. They are treated with great affection, and I've seen many arrive eager and leave happy, wagging their tails. It's clear that the entire veterinary team cares deeply about their work and performs it very well. Thank you from the bottom of my heart to everyone. I don't remember all your names except for Paula and Laura; you are fantastic and deserve a round of applause.

On Friday night, we took our dog Luna to the vet after an accident, fearing the worst. I can't thank Laura, Marta, Raquel, and Paula enough for everything they did for her.

Not only did they save Luna and care for her with incredible professionalism, but they also showed amazing compassion to us, especially to me, as I arrived terrified and feeling incredibly guilty. Since then, they have kept us informed with great care, warmth, and clarity.

We are absolutely delighted with the treatment, attention, care, and sensitivity with which they have treated Luna. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your professionalism and your humanity.

Months ago, we took a baby kitten to the vet in the middle of the night because it wouldn't eat and many hours had passed. The reception wasn't exactly friendly (we called first to explain the situation, and when they arrived, the first thing they said was, "Oh, yes. It's died?" in a completely indifferent tone. First of all, zero empathy, and second, why on earth would I go to your emergency room at 3 a.m. if it's already dead?). But on top of that, they didn't do anything for it there! The vet tried to feed it with the mother's milk we had brought (he gave it to it cold, by the way), saw that the kitten still wouldn't eat, and suggested taking an x-ray. He said it was very small and that it probably wouldn't show anything very clearly, but that we should try it just in case (the x-ray cost 80 euros, of course). When he explained it to us, he did so in a way that only scared us, and then he ended up saying it just had gas, that a little massage at home would be enough to make it eat. He didn't even explain how to massage him or try anything himself. If the problem really was gas, the least he could have done was explain in more detail how to get him to eat, considering the price I was paying.
The cat still wouldn't eat, so we called again. Their solution: admit him. We decided to ignore it because he was so small and we were scared. We didn't see much point in leaving him alone with them after the consultation had gone so badly.
We had to go back to the emergency room the next morning. To a different one, of course. There they confirmed that the x-rays were terribly done, that nothing could be seen on them because they can't be taken that way for a kitten, and that the problem was indigestion mixed with some gas, but that he was fine and healthy. They repeated the x-rays free of charge (much better this time; I could clearly see the difference), did an ultrasound, gave him an injection for his tummy, gave us lots of instructions, gave us a can of wet food just in case, and some gauze. The next day he finally started eating.

What I mean by this is that there are many emergency vets, some better than others. I don't plan on going back to this one. I think paying 180 euros for them to do absolutely nothing for my cat and leaving me just as sad and stressed isn't worth it at all. I spent the night crying because I thought he was going to die. Once was enough. It makes me so angry to think I gave them all that money for nothing.
It's a pleasure to receive reviews like this, Alejandra! We want to thank you for taking the time to leave your comment and we hope to see you here again very soon. Best regards!

Bowie, my 11-year-old cat, died on April 24th. Three weeks earlier, her insurance with Caservet had been automatically renewed. When she was hospitalized in an emergency, the insurance, which was supposedly "health insurance," covered €100 of the more than €2,500 bill for hospitalization, tests, and diagnostic imaging. This is what they now call "preventive" insurance, and it's useless when you really need it. Furthermore, the small discount they offer only applies to their clinic in Sanchinarro.

When I called to cancel the policy after her death, they told me they would continue charging me until March 2027. They said, "The policy is annual, even though you pay monthly." My cat is dead. There's nothing left to insure. And they're still charging me.

The most surreal thing is that their own terms and conditions state that the contract ends when the insured animal dies. The DGSFP (Spanish Directorate General of Insurance and Pension Funds) has an official policy stating that they shouldn't charge a single additional premium after death. Even so, they refuse to cancel it. I had to file a formal complaint with the regulator.

I see several comments complaining about the same thing; I suggest you also file a complaint with the DGSFP (Spanish Directorate General of Insurance and Pension Funds) because it's a complete scam.

So, if you're thinking of getting Caservet insurance because you want real emergency coverage—don't. It's better to have some savings and then go to your preferred veterinarian when you need it.

I hope this helps someone. 🐱
Thank you for trusting our veterinary clinic in Sanchinarro. You can describe your experience to us at info@caservet.es so we can see how to resolve the issue. Have a great day, Pau!

We just came from the emergency vet with my dog ​​Delta. We're new to the area and didn't know where to take her, so we went here. Laura and Paula took care of us; they were both incredibly professional and kind—amazing professionals. 100% recommended.
Excellent service.
Very kind, giving a quick response and solution to my dog's problem.
I was there this afternoon for an emergency and the treatment and care given to my dog ​​was a 10/10, I recommend it one hundred percent, thank you.

It's a disgrace what that clinic has become... ugh... goodbye forever... and I'm going to make sure that all my acquaintances who take their pets there get the hell out of there... I want to make it clear that the people who work there are completely innocent...
Very good
Hi Daniel! Thank you so much for your feedback. At Caservet, we work every day to keep improving and offering the best insurance to our clients. Best regards!

I am truly grateful for the care and professionalism of all the staff, both assistants and veterinarians. I arrived very distressed because the kennel where my dog ​​had been had returned her to me in terrible condition, with a very serious injury to her tail, practically rotting away, and having lost half of it. Even so, thanks to your work, patience, and dedication, my dog ​​is still a happy dog, although the process has been very difficult for both of us.

For a whole month, we went every day for her treatment, and we always felt supported and cared for. Your dedication and the love with which you treat the animals are evident, something absolutely essential in such an important and delicate profession as yours.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kindness, your humanity, and for calming me down during one of the most difficult times I've experienced with her.

I'm not posting photos of the condition she was in when I got her because it was truly critical, and I don't want to upset anyone, but I am sharing a photo of her tail completely healed and my dog ​​as happy as ever, thanks to you all. ❤️

I have no doubt that I will always leave Mikasa in your care. You are an amazing team, and we will be eternally grateful.

Big hugs from Sofía and Mikasa 🐾
Hi Andre! Thank you so much for your feedback. At Caservet, we work every day to keep improving and offering the best insurance to our clients. Best regards!
Hello MALGORZATA! Thank you so much for your feedback. At Caservet, we work every day to keep improving and offering the best insurance to our clients. Best regards!

Terrible dentist. We went to this clinic for our dog's dental emergency, and the experience with the dentist was disastrous, to the point that we were forced to take legal action.

In January, our dog broke both canines while playing with a stick. We were referred to the dentist, who performed a root canal and composite restoration on one canine, and a composite restoration on the other, which had a lateral fracture. We were told that he would be able to resume his normal activities in a few days.

A few days later, the composite restoration on the lateral canine fell out. We took him back, and they repeated the same treatment, charging us only for the anesthesia. Just four days after this second restoration, it fell out again. In other words, the same repair failed again very quickly, forcing our dog to undergo further procedures and anesthesia. When we complained, the dentist's response was that "these things can happen" and that he couldn't guarantee that a treatment would work.

They then suggested a titanium crown, which we agreed to, hoping for a permanent solution. This required two more anesthetics: one to prepare the canine tooth and another to place the crown. During the last procedure, they told us it would be brief, but the anesthesia lasted over 60 minutes, and the price increased by about 40%.

The worst part happened when we picked up our dog: the canine tooth that had undergone the root canal, which had been inserted intact, came out broken after the procedure. We reported this immediately, and the only solution offered was to put on another crown—in other words, to continue charging us, without assuming any responsibility for the damage caused while the dog was under their care.

After spending nearly €1,800 and subjecting our dog to four anesthetics for treatments that didn't work, we feel utterly helpless. We're not just talking about the money; we're talking about the health of an animal repeatedly subjected to anesthetics and procedures that could have been avoided due to poor workmanship.

The dentist's attitude was arrogant, domineering, and completely unprofessional. When something went wrong, it was all excuses; when it was time to take responsibility, they vanished.

I want to make it clear that the rest of the clinic staff always treated us wonderfully. It's a shame that just one person has completely ruined our trust in this center. Be very careful if you go there for a complex dental case.
